subject: Английский язык
authors: Комарова Ю. А., Ларионова И. В.

problems.condition: Unit 1 Sounds and Intonation, упр. 1, с. 6. 1) Прослушай и повтори слова. 2) Назови предметы на картинках с артиклем the (перед гласной — /ðɪ/).
steps: the orange — апельсин, the apple — яблоко, the octopus — осьминог, the insect — насекомое, the umbrella — зонт.
Перед гласным звуком the читается /ðɪ/.
problems.answer: the octopus, the insect, the umbrella, the apple, the orange — /ðɪ/ перед гласной

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 2, с. 6. 1) Прослушай и повтори. 2) Назови предметы с артиклем the (перед согласной — /ðə/).
steps: the boys — мальчики, the school — школа, the fish — рыба, the mice — мыши, the feet — ноги.
Перед согласным звуком the читается /ðə/.
problems.answer: the boys, the mice, the feet, the fish, the school — /ðə/ перед согласной

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 3, с. 6. Произнеси слова с артиклем the, выбирая /ðə/ или /ðɪ/.
steps: /ðə/ cow, /ðə/ boat, /ðɪ/ ice cream, /ðɪ/ orange, /ðə/ flower, /ðɪ/ elephant, /ðə/ tree.
problems.answer: the cow /ðə/, the boat /ðə/, the ice cream /ðɪ/, the orange /ðɪ/, the flower /ðə/, the elephant /ðɪ/

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 4, с. 7. Прослушай и повтори слова с wr- и wh-.
steps: wr → /r/ (w не читается): write — писать, wrong — неправильно, wrist — запястье, wrap — заворачивать. wh → /w/: whale — кит, white — белый, wheel — колесо, wheat — пшеница.
problems.answer: write, wrong, wrist, wrap (/r/); whale, white, wheel, wheat (/w/)

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 5, с. 7. 1) Прослушай и повтори вопросительные слова. 2) Задай специальные вопросы с ними.
steps: 1) where — где, what — что / какой, when — когда, who — кто, whose — чей.
2) Where do you live? — In Moscow. What games do you play? — Hide-and-seek. Who is your friend? — Denis. When is your birthday? — In May. Whose bag is this? — It's Ann's.
problems.answer: where, what, when, who, whose + примеры вопросов

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 6, с. 8. Прослушай и повтори слова с непроизносимой l.
steps: talk — говорить, walk — ходить пешком, half — половина, calf — телёнок, palm — ладонь / пальма, calm — спокойный. Буква l не читается.
problems.answer: talk, walk, half, calf, palm, calm — l не произносится

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 7, с. 8. 1) Назови картинки. 2) Спроси, как это по-английски и как пишется.
steps: 1) palm, calf, walk, half.
2) A: What's the English for «телёнок»? — B: Calf. — A: How do you spell it? — B: C-a-l-f. — A: Thank you!
problems.answer: What's the English for …? How do you spell it? — palm, calf, walk, half

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 8, с. 9. Прослушай и повтори слова с непроизносимыми t и n.
steps: listen — слушать, whistle — свистеть, castle — замок, fasten — застёгивать (t не читается); autumn — осень, column — колонна (n не читается).
problems.answer: listen, whistle, castle, fasten (немая t); autumn, column (немая n)

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 9, с. 9. Прочитай слова с непроизносимыми буквами.
steps: listen, whistle, castle, fasten, autumn, column.
problems.answer: listen, whistle, castle, fasten, autumn, column

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 10, с. 9. Спроси, как пишутся слова (How do you spell…?).
steps: A: How do you spell "listen"? — B: L-i-s-t-e-n. — A: You're right! A: How do you spell "whistle"? — B: W-h-i-s-t-l-e. A: How do you spell "castle"? — B: C-a-s-t-l-e.
problems.answer: How do you spell …? — по буквам: listen, whistle, castle, autumn

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 11, с. 10. Прослушай и повтори сочетания со связующим звуком /r/.
steps: there are, where are, here is, are at — на стыке слов появляется звук /r/.
problems.answer: there are, where are, here is, are at — связующий /r/

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 12, с. 10. 1) Прочитай предложения со связующим /r/. 2) Опиши классную комнату с There is / There are.
steps: 1) Here it is! Where are we? The boys and girls are at home. There are trees and flowers in the park.
2) There is a board on the wall near the door. There is a teacher's table in front of it. There is a computer on the table. There are ten desks and twenty chairs in the classroom.
problems.answer: There is a board / a table / a computer; there are ten desks and twenty chairs

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 13, с. 11. Прослушай и повтори краткие формы.
steps: I am — I'm; there is — there's; it is — it's; we are — we're; he has — he's; it has — it's; they have — they've.
problems.answer: I'm, there's, it's, we're, he's, it's, they've

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 14, с. 11. Прочитай предложения с краткими формами.
steps: We're friends. They've got the stars. There's a book on the table.
problems.answer: We're friends. They've got the stars. There's a book on the table.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 15, с. 12. Прослушай и повтори фразы с and (слабая форма /ən/).
steps: and trousers — a jumper and trousers — She's wearing a jumper and trousers. and trees — flowers and trees — lots of flowers and trees.
problems.answer: and читается слабо /ən/: a jumper and trousers, flowers and trees

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 16, с. 12. Прочитай предложения, обращая внимание на and.
steps: She's wearing a jumper and trousers. There are lots of flowers and trees. The boys and girls are at school.
problems.answer: She's wearing a jumper and trousers. There are lots of flowers and trees.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 17, с. 13. Прослушай и повтори общие вопросы (интонация вверх).
steps: Are you a pupil? Are you ten? Have you got toys? Do you like swimming? Is there a living room in your house?
problems.answer: Общие вопросы произносятся с повышением голоса в конце.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 18, с. 13. Прочитай диалог Сэма и Сью по ролям.
steps: Sam: Hi, Sue! Sue: Hello! Sam: This is my little sister, Helen. Have you got a sister? Sue: Yes, I have. Her name is Kate.
problems.answer: Диалог с общим вопросом Have you got a sister? — Yes, I have.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 19, с. 13. Ответь на общие вопросы из упр. 17.
steps: Yes, I am / No, I'm not. Yes, I am / No, I'm not. Yes, I have / No, I haven't. Yes, I do / No, I don't. Yes, there is / No, there isn't.
problems.answer: Yes, I am; Yes, I am; Yes, I have; Yes, I do; Yes, there is (или отрицательные)

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 20, с. 14. Прослушай и повтори специальные вопросы (интонация вниз).
steps: What's your name? How are you? Where are your parents now? When is your birthday? Who is your friend? How old are you?
problems.answer: Специальные вопросы произносятся с понижением голоса.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 21, с. 14. Прочитай диалог Сэма и Сью по ролям.
steps: Sam: What's your name? Sue: My name's Sue. What's your name? Sam: I'm Sam. How old are you? Sue: I'm ten. When is your birthday? Sam: In June.
problems.answer: Диалог-знакомство: What's your name? How old are you? When is your birthday?

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 22, с. 14. Задай другу специальные вопросы.
steps: What's your name? How old are you? When is your birthday? How many friends have you got? Who is your friend? Where do you live?
problems.answer: What / How old / When / How many / Who / Where …?

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 23, с. 15. Назови непроизносимые буквы в словах.
steps: calf — l; castle — t; column — n; write — w; whistle — t; walk — l; autumn — n; wrong — w.
problems.answer: calf (l), castle (t), column (n), write (w), whistle (t), walk (l), autumn (n), wrong (w)

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 24, с. 15. 1) Повтори правила интонации и связующего /r/. 2) Прочитай предложения.
steps: 1) Специальные вопросы — интонация вниз, общие — вверх. Связующий /r/ появляется между гласными: where are, there is.
2) When is your birthday? There are flowers in the park. Is there an apple in the orange bag? Where are we?
problems.answer: Правила интонации; предложения прочитаны с /r/

chapters.title: 1. Sounds and Intonation. Meet the Story Characters

problems.condition: Unit 1, Meet the Story Characters, упр. 1, с. 17. Прочитай, как герои представляются.
steps: Hello! I'm Brill. I'm from Brilliant Island. Look at this ship. Here are my friends: Alice, Denzil, Nora and Bertie.
problems.answer: Герои: Brill с острова Бриллиант и его друзья Alice, Denzil, Nora, Bertie.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 2, с. 17. Посчитай героев и предметы на картинке.
steps: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
problems.answer: one … ten

problems.condition: Unit 2 This is Happy Town, упр. 1, с. 19. Прослушай и повтори слова со звуками /ð/ и /θ/.
steps: /ð/: this, these, that, those, they, there. /θ/: three, mouth, thirsty, tooth, bath, birthday.
problems.answer: /ð/ this, these, that, those, they, there; /θ/ three, mouth, thirsty, tooth, bath, birthday

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 2, с. 19. 1) Прослушай и назови слово, которое услышал. 2) Прочитай пары слов.
steps: 1) there, sat, way, those, three, mouse.
2) there — where; that — sat; they — way; those — toes; three — tree; mouth — mouse.
problems.answer: there, sat, way, those, three, mouse; пары: there — where, that — sat, they — way, those — toes, three — tree, mouth — mouse

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 3, с. 20. Прослушай и повтори новые слова.
steps: campsite — кемпинг, tent — палатка, town — город.
problems.answer: campsite, tent, town

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 4, с. 20. Прослушай историю и скажи, куда приплыли друзья.
steps: The friends are travelling on a ship and see a nice town — Happy Town. The ship stops near the town.
problems.answer: They come to Happy Town.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 5, с. 20. Прочитай историю по ролям.
steps: Brill: Look! There are lots of trees. Denzil: Yes. And houses. Let's go! Alice: Is that a school? There are nice flowers. Bertie: I'm hungry!
problems.answer: История о прибытии в Happy Town прочитана по ролям.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 6, с. 21. Выбери предложения, которые соответствуют истории.
steps: 1. There are lots of trees in Happy Town. 4. Bertie is hungry.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 7, с. 22. Спроси, что это, и ответь (What's that? What are those?).
steps: — What's that? — It's a school. — What's that? — It's a campsite. — What are those? — They're tents. — What are those? — They're trees.
problems.answer: What's that? — It's a … What are those? — They're …

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 8, с. 22. Прослушай и соотнеси диалоги с картинками.
problems.answer: b, d, a, c

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 9, с. 23. Спроси, кто это и где он (Who's he? Where's he?).
steps: — Who's he? — He's David. — Where's he? — He's in the shop. — Who's he? — He's Jason. — Where's he? — He's in the tree.
problems.answer: Who's he / she? — He's … Where's he / she? — He's in …

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 10, с. 23. 1) Прочитай разговор по телефону. 2) Опиши картинку кемпинга.
steps: 1) Hello! How are you? I'm in the campsite. Where's Jason? He's in the tent.
2) This is a campsite. There are five children. Jason is in the tree. Clare and David are in the shop. Pete is in the tent. Linda is behind the tent. They're happy.
problems.answer: Описание: … is in the tree / in the shop / in the tent / behind the tent

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 11, с. 24. Прослушай и спой песенку о Счастливом городе.
steps: It's a very nice place, Happy Town. These are flowers, these are trees, that's a girl, those are boys…
problems.answer: Песенка Happy Town с this / these / that / those.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 12, с. 24. Посмотри на картинки A и B и скажи, что где находится.
steps: Picture A is a campsite, picture B is a town. There are two tents in the campsite. There are two shops in the town. There are trees in the campsite.
problems.answer: In the campsite there are tents and trees; in the town there are shops and houses.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 13, с. 24. Сравни картинки A и B.
steps: In picture A there is a campsite with two tents. In picture B there is a town with two shops. There are trees in A and houses in B.
problems.answer: A — campsite, tents, trees; B — town, shops, houses

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 14, с. 25. Прочитай, как представляются дети из разных стран.
steps: Hello! I'm Steve. I'm wearing a red jumper. I'm from England. I'm English. This is my school. Hello! I'm Lucy. I'm from Scotland.
problems.answer: Дети представляются: имя, одежда, страна, национальность.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 15, с. 25. Ответь на вопросы по текстам.
steps: Lucy. England. Red and white. At school.
problems.answer: Lucy; England; red and white; at school

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 16, с. 25. Расскажи о флагах разных стран.
steps: The Russian flag has three stripes: white, blue and red. The British flag is the Union Jack — red, white and blue. The American flag has red and white stripes and white stars on blue.
problems.answer: Russian flag — white, blue, red; British — Union Jack; American — stripes and stars

chapters.title: 2. This is Happy Town. Geography. Country Facts

problems.condition: Unit 2, Geography. Country Facts, упр. 1, с. 26. Прослушай и назови страны.
steps: Italy, the UK, Portugal, Russia.
problems.answer: Italy, the UK, Portugal, Russia

problems.condition: Unit 2, Geography, упр. 2, с. 26. Спроси о столицах стран.
steps: A: What is the capital of Italy? — B: It's Rome. A: Right! What is the capital of Russia? — B: Moscow. What is the capital of Portugal? — B: Lisbon. What is the capital of the UK? — B: London.
problems.answer: What is the capital of …? — Rome, Moscow, Lisbon, London

problems.condition: Unit 2, Geography, упр. 3, с. 26. Напиши о столицах.
steps: London is the capital of the UK. Rome is the capital of Italy. Moscow is the capital of Russia. Lisbon is the capital of Portugal.
problems.answer: London — the UK, Rome — Italy, Moscow — Russia, Lisbon — Portugal

problems.condition: Unit 3 Are They Playing?, упр. 1, с. 27. Прослушай и повтори числительные 13–19.
steps: thirteen — 13, fourteen — 14, fifteen — 15, sixteen — 16, seventeen — 17, eighteen — 18, nineteen — 19.
problems.answer: thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 2, с. 27. Прослушай и повтори скороговорку.
steps: Ninety-nine mice are eating rice. — Девяносто девять мышей едят рис.
problems.answer: Ninety-nine mice are eating rice.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 3, с. 27. Прослушай и запиши числа.
Unit 3, упр. 4, с. 28. Прослушай и повтори новые слова.
steps: watch — смотреть; famous — знаменитый; make a film — снимать фильм; spoil — портить; horrible — ужасный.
problems.answer: watch, famous, make a film, spoil, horrible

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 5, с. 28. Прослушай историю и скажи, что делает Арабелла.
steps: Arabella is making a film in the school playground. She spoils the playground. The children aren't happy.
problems.answer: Arabella is making a film and spoiling the playground.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 6, с. 28. Прочитай историю по ролям.
steps: Brill: This is the school and this is the playground. Nora: Are the children playing? Are they climbing and jumping? Alice: No. Denzil: They're watching. Arabella is making a film!
problems.answer: История об Арабелле, снимающей фильм на школьной площадке.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 7, с. 29. Ответь на вопросы по истории (Present Continuous).
steps: No, they aren't. No, they aren't. Yes, they are. Yes, she is. No, they aren't.
problems.answer: No, they aren't; No, they aren't; Yes, they are; Yes, she is; No, they aren't

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 8, с. 30. Прослушай и повтори названия школьных предметов.
steps: Geography — география, History — история, English — английский, Maths — математика, PE — физкультура, Art — рисование, Science — естествознание, Music — музыка.
problems.answer: Geography, History, English, Maths, PE, Art, Science, Music

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 9, с. 30. Скажи, что дети делают сейчас на картинках.
steps: Picture 2: He's drawing now. Picture 3: They're painting now. Picture 4: They're writing now.
problems.answer: He's drawing; they're painting; they're writing

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 10, с. 31. Скажи, какой урок у детей.
steps: She's doing Art. He's doing Geography. They're doing PE.
problems.answer: She's doing Art; he's doing Geography; they're doing PE

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 11, с. 31. Прослушай и соотнеси.
problems.answer: b, f, a, d, c, e

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 12, с. 31. Заполни пропуски (множественное число, is / are).
steps: men, are, is, person, children.
problems.answer: men, are, is, person, children

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 13, с. 32. Прослушай и повтори десятки.
steps: ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, a hundred.
problems.answer: ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, a hundred

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 14, с. 32. Прослушай и спой песенку о мышках.
steps: Two little mice in the house, they're running up and down the stairs! Twenty-two little mice in the house…
problems.answer: Песенка про мышек с числами 2, 22, 32…

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 15, с. 32. Скажи, какой урок идёт в каждом классе.
steps: In Class 1 they are doing Geography now. In Class 2 — Maths. In Class 3 — English. In Class 4 — Science.
problems.answer: Class 1 — Geography, Class 2 — Maths, Class 3 — English, Class 4 — Science

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 16, с. 33. Прочитай репортажи Клэр из музеев.
steps: Clare is a school TV reporter. I'm in Tate Museum in London. These children are looking at paintings. I'm in the Science Museum. The children are playing with computers.
problems.answer: Репортажи из музеев Лондона: Tate, Science Museum.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 17, с. 33. Ответь на вопросы по репортажам.
steps: Yes, they are. No, they aren't. No, they aren't. Yes, they are.
problems.answer: Yes, they are; No, they aren't; No, they aren't; Yes, they are

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 18, с. 33. Скажи, что ты делаешь сейчас.
steps: I'm answering the questions now. I'm sitting at my desk. I'm writing.
problems.answer: I'm answering the questions now.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Maths. Measurements, упр. 1, с. 34. Соотнеси единицы измерения.
problems.answer: b, e, c, a, d

problems.condition: Unit 4 Otto is Arabella's Brother, упр. 1, с. 35. Прослушай и распредели имена по звуку притяжательного окончания.
steps: /z/: Otto's, Bertie's, Brill's, Arabella's. /s/: Patrick's, Pete's, Olaf's, Philip's. /ɪz/: Alice's, Liz's, Ross's, Trish's.

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 2, с. 35. 1) Прослушай и повтори. 2) Прочитай словосочетания.
steps: Ted's beds. Tess' dresses. Clare's chairs. Ann Cox's boxes.
problems.answer: Ted's beds, Tess' dresses, Clare's chairs, Ann Cox's boxes

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 3, с. 36. Прослушай и повтори новые слова.
steps: car — машина; scary — страшный; food shop — продуктовый магазин.
problems.answer: car, scary, food shop

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 4, с. 36. Прослушай историю и скажи, кто эти люди.
steps: The woman is a terrible person. She lives in a scary house. The man is her brother. He's got a shop. The boy is going to this man's food shop.
problems.answer: The woman — Arabella, the man — her brother Otto, he's got a food shop.

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 5, с. 36. Прочитай историю по ролям.

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 6, с. 37. Скажи, чьи это вещи.

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 7, с. 38. Посмотри на семейное дерево Тани и ответь на вопросы.
steps: Who is Tanya's dad? — Harry. Mum? — Anna. Brother? — Tom. Cousin? — Jim. Grandparents? — Peter and Sophia.
problems.answer: dad — Harry, mum — Anna, brother — Tom, cousin — Jim, grandparents — Peter and Sophia

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 8, с. 38. 1) Спроси, что делают члены семьи Тани. 2) Опиши картинку.
steps: 1) What's Tanya's dad doing? — He is standing. What's her mum doing? — She is sitting. What's Tanya doing? — She is playing with her dog. What's her brother doing? — He is reading. What's her cousin doing? — He is drawing.
